title: On-call and uptime
description: On-call rotas, escalation policies, HTTP uptime monitors and the alerts they raise.
forbidden: On-call requires permission to view schedules and all conversations. Ask your organization admin for access.

fields.name: Name
rotas.hint: Layers hand off in order; a later layer and an override win over earlier ones.
rotas.delete_description: Escalation steps that target this rota fall through to the next step.
rotas.empty_description: Define who is on call and when.
rotas.form_hint: Times are entered in your browser's time zone.
rotas.layers_hint: Each layer rotates through its agents from its start, handing off after the given length.
rotas.overrides_hint: Replace the rota for a window (leave, swaps). Windows cannot overlap.
rotas.calendar_hint: Next {{days}} days (local time, 30-minute resolution). Outlined slots are overrides.
policies.hint: Steps notify in order until the alert is acknowledged.
policies.delete_description: Open alerts and linked uptime monitors lose this policy.
policies.empty_description: Decide who is paged, in which order, for incidents and urgent conversations.
policies.form_hint: Each step has one target; a step's minutes cannot be lower than the previous step's.
policies.steps_hint: 0 minutes: as soon as the alert opens. A deleted target falls through to the next step.
monitors.hint: Checks public HTTP(S) URLs on a schedule; opens an incident and updates the linked component when down.
monitors.delete_description: Its check history is deleted too.
monitors.empty_description: Start watching your site or API.
monitors.form_hint: Private network addresses and redirects are blocked.
monitors.url_hint: A public http:// or https:// address.
monitors.keyword_placeholder: Text that must appear in the response body
monitors.component_hint: The monitor drives this component's status and incidents.
monitors.sparkline: {{up}} of the last {{total}} checks up; last latency {{latency}} ms

alerts.empty_description: Incidents and urgent conversations open alerts here.

incidents.page_description: Service outages and maintenance. Follow the current state here while you answer customers.
